create_olympus_surface: create an OlympusSurface instance with a specified surface kind, dimension, and noise configuration
simulate_surface_with_noise: simulate an Olympus surface evaluation on input data with Gaussian, Uniform, or Gamma noise
run_olympus_emulator: run an OlympusEmulator with a specified dataset and NeuralNet or BayesNeuralNet model
get_surface_evaluation: get the noise-free evaluation of an OlympusSurface using the evaluation_function method
configure_emulator_parametrization: configure an OlympusEmulator parametrization with dataset-derived bounds and dimension
